reuse.why: Reuses d.isWeekend and the rSchedule occurrence API, but puts the new rule beside, not inside, the existing getDateWithWeekendRule/getDateStringWithWeekendRule that the other paths use.

duplication.why: Adds no copied block; the weekend condition (skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend) is now evaluated twice in getNextDate.

placement.why: The rule is in shared/schedules.ts, but inlined into getNextDate's loop rather than in the shared weekend-rule function the tree already has for this decision.

scope.why: Small, focused change plus targeted tests.

maintainability.why: Daily skipping only happens in getNextDate; getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts apply the weekend rule via getDateWithWeekendRule/getDateStringWithWeekendRule and will still move daily weekend dates, so behaviour diverges by path.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts handles daily weekend dates itself instead of extending getDateWithWeekendRule, the shared weekend-rule abstraction.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic, the rule is just placed in one consumer.

one_place.where: Only getNextDate skips daily weekend occurrences; getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and the schedule template loop (server/budget/schedule-template.ts) still move them via getDateWithWeekendRule.
